title: What is ReCircle AI?
tags: about platform what recircle
answer: ReCircle AI connects households with verified local kabadiwalas (scrap collectors) for doorstep pickup of recyclable waste, and runs a second-hand marketplace so usable products get a new home instead of being thrown away.

title: How do I sell my waste?
tags: sell waste collection pickup booking book schedule steps work process
answer: Log in as a customer → Sell Waste → upload a photo of each type of waste → confirm the AI-suggested category → enter an approximate weight → see the indicative price → pick your address, date and time slot → submit. Nearby verified collectors are notified and one of them accepts.

title: Which waste do you accept?
tags: accept waste categories materials newspaper cardboard plastic metal glass e-waste appliances textiles
answer: We accept newspapers, cardboard, books and office paper, PET bottles and hard plastic, iron and steel, aluminium, copper and brass, glass bottles, e-waste (phones, chargers, small electronics), old appliances and textiles. The exact list and current rates are on the Waste Collection page.

title: What is not accepted?
tags: not accepted wet food garbage hazardous medical chemicals
answer: We do not collect wet/food waste, medical or biomedical waste, chemicals, paint, asbestos or anything hazardous. Please use your municipal collection for those.

title: How is the waste price calculated?
tags: rate price calculated estimate per kg
answer: Indicative price = estimated weight × current rate per kg for that material. Rates are managed by our admin team and shown on the Waste Collection page. The final price is based on the weight the collector verifies at your doorstep.

title: Why is the final amount different from the estimate?
tags: final amount different estimate verified weight dispute
answer: Your estimate uses the weight you entered. The collector weighs the material in front of you and enters the verified weight and agreed rate. You then review it — if it looks wrong you can dispute it and the collector must re-verify before you confirm.

title: How do I get paid for scrap?
tags: payment scrap paid cash upi receipt
answer: The collector pays you on the spot by cash, UPI or bank transfer after weighing. Once you confirm in the app, a digital receipt is generated and the transaction appears in Wallet / Transactions.

title: No collector accepted my request
tags: no collector accepted rejected unavailable
answer: If every nearby collector declines, the request is marked Rejected and you are notified. Try another date or time slot, or contact support — admins can also assign a collector manually.

title: Can I cancel a pickup?
tags: cancel booking pickup
answer: Yes. Open My Bookings and cancel while the booking is Pending, Accepted or Collector Assigned. Once the collector is on the way, contact support to cancel.

title: What do the booking statuses mean?
tags: booking status pending accepted on the way arrived weight verified awaiting confirmation completed
answer: Pending → waiting for a collector. Accepted / Collector Assigned → a collector will come. On The Way → travelling to you. Arrived → at your door. Weight Verified / Awaiting Customer Confirmation → check the weight and amount, then confirm. Completed → receipt issued and eco-points added.

title: Do collectors see my address?
tags: privacy address phone collector see location
answer: Before a collector accepts, they only see your locality, the materials, estimated weight and an approximate distance. Your exact address and phone number are shared only with the collector who accepts the booking.

title: How do I become a kabadiwala on ReCircle?
tags: become collector kabadiwala register join verification
answer: Go to Become a Kabadiwala, fill in your business details, ID proof, service areas on the map, working days and time slots. Our admin team verifies your details; once approved you start receiving nearby pickup requests.

title: How long does collector verification take?
tags: collector kabadiwala verification verified verify approval approved time pending trusted
answer: Most applications are reviewed within 1–2 working days. You'll get a notification and email when your account is approved or if we need more details.

title: How do I sell a used product?
tags: sell used product listing create marketplace
answer: Customer dashboard → Sell Used Products → upload up to 6 photos → enter title, brand, condition, age and original price → use the AI to get a reuse/repair/donate/recycle suggestion, a price range and a draft description → edit anything you like → publish.

title: What is the Reuse vs Recycle recommendation?
tags: ai recommendation reuse recycle repair donate engine
answer: When you add an item, our engine weighs its condition, age, category and any faults you describe and suggests Reuse (sell it), Repair, Donate or Recycle — with the reasons it used. It's only a suggestion; you choose what to do.

title: How does the AI price suggestion work?
tags: ai price suggestion range product value
answer: We start from the original price, apply typical depreciation for the category and age, adjust for condition and brand, and blend in prices of similar items actually sold on ReCircle. You get a range, not an exact market value.

title: How accurate is the waste photo classification?
tags: ai classification accuracy photo image wrong category
answer: The AI suggests a material from your photo with a confidence score. It can be wrong for mixed piles or poor lighting, so you can always change the category before booking. The demo version uses a simple colour/texture heuristic and says so on screen.

title: How do I buy a product?
tags: buy purchase product request order
answer: Open a product → Request to Buy, optionally with an offer and message. The seller accepts or declines. After acceptance, arrange the handover through in-app messages, pay (cash/UPI, or online if enabled), and the seller confirms the handover to complete the order.

title: What do the order statuses mean?
tags: order status requested accepted completed rejected cancelled reserved
answer: Requested → waiting for the seller. Accepted → the item is reserved for you; arrange the handover. Completed → the seller confirmed the handover. Rejected/Cancelled → the request was closed. An order is never marked complete just because a request was sent.

title: How do I contact a seller safely?
tags: contact seller message chat safe phone number
answer: Use the Message Seller button. Phone numbers and emails typed in chat are hidden until the seller accepts your purchase request, which protects both sides from spam and fraud. Always inspect items before paying.

title: Safety tips for buying and selling
tags: safety tips fraud scam meet
answer: Meet in a public or well-lit place, inspect the item before paying, never pay an advance to someone you have not met, and report suspicious listings through Complaints. Our admins can remove fraudulent listings.

title: What are eco-reward points?
tags: eco reward points earn
answer: You earn eco-points for completed, verified activity: points per kg of verified recyclable waste, and points for selling or buying a pre-loved product. Points appear in Eco Impact.

title: How is my environmental impact calculated?
tags: impact environment carbon co2 calculated
answer: Eco Impact shows measured numbers only: kilograms of each material verified at completed pickups and the number of products reused through completed sales. We don't show CO₂ savings because that needs validated, region-specific emission factors.

title: How do I save products?
tags: favourite save wishlist heart
answer: Tap the heart icon on any product to add it to My Favourites. You'll find them in your dashboard.

title: How do I change my password or profile?
tags: account password change profile phone address
answer: Go to Profile to update your name, phone, photo and saved addresses, and Settings to change your password.

title: What are customer, buyer and collector accounts?
tags: roles customer buyer collector account type
answer: Customers sell waste and list used products (and can buy too). Buyers browse and buy second-hand products. Collectors (kabadiwalas) receive and complete pickup requests after admin verification.

title: How do I raise a complaint?
tags: complaint issue problem support help report
answer: Use the Complaints option (or Contact Us) with the booking or order reference. Our admin team reviews every complaint and you'll be notified of updates.

title: Which cities do you serve?
tags: city cities service area location available
answer: Service depends on verified collectors near you. When you book, we only match collectors whose service radius covers your location. The demo data covers Bengaluru.

title: How should I prepare e-waste?
tags: e-waste prepare phone laptop data battery
answer: Back up and wipe personal data, remove SIM and memory cards, and take out removable batteries. If the device still works, consider listing it for reuse instead — it's usually worth more.
